title: goodness the existentialisn't is transformative @HERE Arts Center 💜 #...
transcript: imagine you walk into a theatre and this is what you see a woman in a tank of water moving swimming in a beautiful white dress singing you will not be able to look away from this so captivating it is like a a baptism almost this is how The Essentialisn't Eisa Davis's new piece at Here Arts Center begins Eisa Davis is an incredible artist performer actress singer most recently she is the co creator of the Warriors concept album with Lin Manuel Miranda and The Essentialisn't is hard to explain because it is theatre but it is also a piece of living artwork it is performance And it’s an exploration of this can you be black and not perform? obviously I am a white woman this is not my lived experience and I'm so glad I saw it because it was so eye opening and thought provoking and like a meditation and it explores the idea of being a black performer black woman black artist through music and movement and these stunning visuals I don't really wanna spoil anything cause I think you should see this for yourself but there's a moment where the whole audience together purposely sings badly and just being like in a room full of people all singing together all singing badly together was so freeing and New York and beautiful I just I loved it I didn't always understand every layer and that is okay but I appreciated every single moment 70 minutes it's only running until September 28th I can't express to you how cool it is to see Eisa Davis live go and see it listen learn show up support black performers support black women this is not an experience you're gonna Wanna miss
